Professional case · Video walkthrough / 2026

From a business need to a handover that lasts.

A guided sales-support application with Power Apps, SharePoint catalogues and automated environment setup. A walkthrough of my freelance delivery process: analyse, build, validate and hand over.

Watch the walkthrough

The project in action

2:58 min
Read the transcript

0:00This is how I turn a business need into a Power Platform solution: from requirements to an application that can be tested, installed and maintained.

0:10I start by cross-checking the documents, content and design supplied. I turn each request into a clear scope, acceptance criteria and an assessment of its impact.

0:23Next, I connect the user’s decisions in a guided journey. Each choice feeds the next screen and final result, with coherent, responsive navigation.

0:36I organise the content in SharePoint: catalogues, relationships, recommendations and images. The data model and dictionary explain what each field stores and how it is used.

0:50With Power Automate, I prepare the structure and initial Excel data load. Connections and environment variables make the destination configurable, independent of a development site.

1:03In Power Apps, I implement reusable components, formulas and loading states. I review spacing, buttons, windows and behaviour on desktop, tablet and mobile.

1:15[On screen: a recommendation brings together context, supporting arguments and product images. A window expands the details, and the library provides reference materials.]

1:33The next iteration adds prompts that use the selected context. The user chooses a mission, reviews the text, copies it or emails it to themselves.

1:47I validate what the user receives: correct context, complete text, copying and email. I also check regressions and presentation with evidence from the test environment.

2:02The handover includes six documents: installation, data model, dictionary, user manual, administration and version record. I use screenshots and instructions to support knowledge transfer.

2:17I prepare a package with the solution, content and documentation aligned. I check versions, files and configuration so another team can follow the installation process.

2:33When a change is needed, I assess its impact, fix, test and update the affected documents. Then I integrate the change in Git and prepare the next handover.

2:47My approach connects analysis, data, development, testing and documentation. The result is a traceable, maintainable solution that is ready to evolve.

Project technologies

The starting point

Turn documents, content and design into a coherent experience: select a sector and a challenge, explore recommendations and reuse the context in prompt templates. Content needed to remain editable, and another team needed to be able to install and maintain the solution.

How I built it

  1. Agree the scope: cross-check the supplied materials, define acceptance criteria and assess the impact of each request before implementation.
  2. Connect experience and data: design the guided journey and organise SharePoint catalogues, relationships and images, with a data model and dictionary.
  3. Build and prepare the environment: implement Power Apps components, Power Fx formulas and loading states. Power Automate creates the structure and loads Excel content into a configurable destination.
  4. Validate what the user receives: check context, complete text, copying, email and regressions. Review desktop, tablet and mobile with evidence from the test environment.
  5. Transfer knowledge: prepare installation, data model, dictionary, user manual, administration and version record documents, with screenshots and instructions.
  6. Deliver and evolve: align the solution, content and documentation. For a change, review dependencies, fix, test, update affected documents and version the work with Git.

The result

The video shows a handover organised into solution, content and documentation, including a correction followed by a new version. My aim is for the receiving team to understand, install and continue evolving the application.

What we store
